title: fix(app-shell): the report name box and the dashboard card title box say when readers are served a translation instead of the saved text
body:

_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GNMYnbm5cgRkMqUGpXobrR)_
Fixes #36481
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQD4KwKe5BckFpeiuB

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：中文管理员在报表页「编辑」面板改名称、在仪表盘卡片面板改标题时，如果读者实际看到的是一条译文而不是这里保存的文字，名称框下面会在保存前出现一句提示，写明读者看到的译文，并告诉他去 Studio 的「全部元数据」›「翻译」里改；以前保存后框里又变回译文，没有任何说明。
- 为什么做：替管理员补上上一张报表/仪表盘业务用语卡留下的缺口——环境里自建的报表或仪表盘、以及定制包自带译文的已安装报表，改名后读者仍看到旧译文。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是提示该出现时没出现，或出现了却不准确（只影响一行灰色说明文字，不改保存内容和读者看到的文字）；可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Route 2 of the card (the note), chosen on a measured reading (below).

- `servedLabel.ts`: new `servedLabelNote(current, pair, language)`, judged on the served/authored pair the panel already reads and nothing else (no new read). Two kinds:
  - `kept`: the published label has its own entry for this language (the entry an edit replaces) and readers are served another text. A translation answers ahead of any entry written here, so the note shows before any edit. This is the state after Save in both of the card's cases.
  - `ifKept`: the published label has no entry for this language, readers are served a translation of it, and the box holds an edit. The note names the translation and says readers keep seeing it after Save if it is kept in the environment's own translations or in the customization package.
  - No note when the box's own text is the served one, when the served text in this language is the published one (the entry is served, or no translation exists), or on an untouched box over a translated source.
- `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx` (the report page's Edit panel and Studio) and `DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx` (the dashboard page's card panel and Studio): the note under the name / title box (`role="note"`); on the card panel the title input is `aria-describedby` the note.
- Studio catalogue (en, zh): `engine.inspector.servedLabel.kept`, `engine.inspector.servedLabel.ifKept`. Both name where to change the text: Studio › All metadata › Translation.
- The server's order is unchanged (ruling record 6631250894). Save writes no translation row.

### Route reading (the card's "pick one")

Measured at `origin/main` `87c7bbaf`: the console's only translation-row write is the All metadata area's form editor for a `translation` item (`StudioBundleItemEditor`, one locale bundle per record; an override of a base's translation replaces the whole bundle, ADR-0146 D2). The report and dashboard save paths write the report or dashboard item only, and nothing in the console reads which translation record supplies `reports.NAME.label` or a widget title: the server merges every bundle before it translates (`translateMetaList` and the item twin in `meta-item-read-gate.ts` read `translationBundleOf(i18n)`), and `GET /api/v1/i18n/translations/LOCALE` serves the merged result. A Save that writes the row would need a new server read to address it, so route 1 needs a server change; route 2 was taken.

## Tests

- New `servedLabelNote-36481.test.tsx` (13 cases). The report page panel and the dashboard card panel, each mounted with the context its host builds (`servedReportTextOf` as `ReportView` does, `servedWidgetTextOf` as `DashboardInPageEditor` does) and a draft the panel's patches land in:
  - no packaged base: untouched box shows the served translation and no note; an edit shows the `ifKept` note naming the served text, before Save;
  - no packaged base after Save and reload (published `{ default, zh-CN: EDIT }`, served the bundle text): the `kept` note, before any edit;
  - an override whose pair translates the slot: the `kept` note naming the pair's text;
  - controls: the entry served (an installed item with no pair translation): no note, no `aria-describedby`; no translation for the language: an edit shows no note.
  - On the function: no pair or no served text; an en reader over a zh entry; a box whose own text is the served one; a base-tag `zh` entry counts as the `zh-CN` reader's own.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 to 0, blob `f84b3edf` to `aeb19009`): `servedLabelNote` made to return `null` up front: 7 of 13 red (every note case), the 6 controls green; restored, blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Note prose is not pinned; its kind and the served text it names are.

## Acceptance notes

- The `ifKept` note is conditional on purpose. On a first edit over a plain-string source, the served/authored pair cannot tell the package's own translation (the edit wins, after #36373) from the environment's or the pair's (the edit loses): all three serve a plain translated string. Telling them apart needs the hosts to pass whether the item has a packaged base and whether the pair translates the slot, outside this card's file surface (`ReportView`, `DashboardInPageEditor`, `StudioDesignSurface`). So on an installed item with no pair translation the first edit shows a note whose condition does not hold. After Save the `kept` note is exact.
- Edge, not reachable in the sources measured by #36373's census (0 inline maps on these slots): a package that ships an inline map equal to its own base's entry, with a bundle translation for the same language, would show `kept` while an edit would win.
- The report panel's note is not wired as `aria-describedby` on its input: the input is the shared `InspectorTextField` atom (`_shared.tsx`), outside the file surface; the note is `role="note"` directly under it.
- Live round trip (edit in zh-CN, Save, reload in a running console): NOT MEASURED, reason: no live stack run in this pass; the pins sit on the panels with the hosts' own pairing functions.
- Clause-②: the two new keys land in `@object-ui/i18n`'s studio catalogue, declared as a string-to-string `Record` in the built `dist/namespaces/studio/en.d.ts` (rebuilt after the edit; the keys are in `dist/namespaces/studio/en.js` and `zh.js`), so the published type is unchanged.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/servedLabelNote-36481.test.tsx` — expect 13 passed.

Read first: `servedLabel.ts` (`servedLabelNote` and the header's two kinds), then the note block under the name box in `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx`, then the title Field in `DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx`.
